question: What is CI/CD and why is it important?
intendedUser: Professional in Track-A with early-career experience
description: Conceptual interview question for Track-A professionals.
exampleAnswer: CI/CD automates build, test, and deployment. In my project, I set up GitHub Actions to run tests on every PR and deploy to staging automatically. This caught 12 bugs before production in the first month. CI/CD reduces manual errors and enables faster, more reliable releases.
weakAnswerPitfalls: Vague or generic response without specific examples
Focusing on process without mentioning personal contribution
Failing to connect to the target role
evaluationCriteria: Clarity, devops, specific examples, measurable outcomes
followUpQuestions: How does this apply to the Track-A role?
Can you provide more specific examples?
What would you do differently next time?
